pricing.customer_discount: customer_id -> Decimal multiplier (10% off = Decimal("0.90"); unknown customer = Decimal("1"))

tax.tax_for: (customer_id, lines, discount_multiplier) -> (tax_amount Decimal dollars rounded to cent half-up, rate Decimal multiplier, e.g. Decimal("1.0825"); unknown customer -> (Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("1")))
tax.lines: list of (sku, line_amount Decimal before discount) for KNOWN skus only, in order of the order

why: agent3 (invoice) calls these; invoice does no tax rules and no pricing data lookups beyond these functions
